textoCompleto: One sunny day, a mighty lion was sleeping in the jungle. His mane was big and his body was strong. A tiny mouse was running through the jungle and did not see the lion. The mouse ran right over the lion's nose! The lion woke up with a loud roar. He grabbed the mouse with his big paw. 'How dare you wake me up! I will eat you!' said the lion. The mouse was very scared. 'Please, great lion, do not eat me! Spare my life, and one day I will help you,' said the mouse. The lion laughed and laughed. 'You? Help me? You are so small! How could you ever help me?' But the lion was not hungry, so he let the mouse go. 'Thank you, lion! You will not regret this,' said the mouse as he ran away. A few weeks later, the lion was walking through the jungle when he fell into a trap. Hunters had placed a large net on the ground. The lion was trapped and could not escape. He roared as loud as he could. 'Help! Help! Someone help me!' The mouse heard the lion's roars. He ran as fast as his little legs could carry him. When he saw the lion in the net, he said, 'Do not worry, lion. I will help you.' The mouse began to gnaw on the ropes with his sharp teeth. He gnawed and gnawed until one rope broke. Then another. And another. Finally, the lion was free. The lion was very grateful. 'Thank you, little mouse. You were so small, but you saved my life. I was wrong to laugh at you,' said the lion. The mouse smiled and said, 'Even the smallest friend can be a great friend.' The lion and the mouse became the best of friends.
